tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Korda black. The logo, headlines, and dark slide backgrounds. Primary brand color.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on black: cards, tables, and panels on dark slides.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white (4.7:1). On ink-900 it is 3.9:1: use it there only at 24px and up.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, and soft panels on white slides; upcoming steps on a taut line.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: White. Light slide backgrounds and every mark on black.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Slide background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, and table bands on bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on bg.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, sources, and page numbers on bg. On dark slides it uses ink-100, because ink-500 is too faint for small text on black.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The bar and every element drawn from it: cursor, taut line, anchor, hanging strings.

tokens.name: mark-alt
tokens.usage: A second tone for the bar when two marks sit side by side.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, and the unfinished part of a taut line.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Product UI only: step or test finished and passing. Always paired with a text label.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Product UI only: waiting for a human decision, such as an approval. Always paired with a text label.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Product UI only: step or test failed, or an action is blocked. Always paired with a text label.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Cover and statement slides. One line, at most two.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section dividers and slide titles that carry the message.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: The title of a content slide.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Column heads, card titles, key points.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every slide makes one point, in one sentence.
styles.usage: Running text and bullets. Never smaller on a slide meant to be presented.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sources, footnotes, chart labels, page numbers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above titles and key points.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Section numbers and a single hero number.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a cursor bar and its word; tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between paragraphs and list items; between hanging strings.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between columns and cards; anchor bar to its text.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a slide title and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top and bottom slide margin.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Left and right slide margin.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: The bar at slide size (22 × 70 px). The logo bar's corner is about 18% of its width.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, images, and app icons: the logo tile's corner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The palette pills, and only where the palette itself is shown.

proportion.note: Fixed ratios taken from the logo.

tokens.name: bar-aspect
tokens.usage: Bar width ÷ height (17 × 54 in the logo). Keep it for the cursor and anchor bars; hanging strings may be any length.

tokens.name: bar-width-slide
tokens.usage: Bar width on a 1920 × 1080 slide.
